# LiveSimulators — Interactive First-Principles Engineering Simulators

> LiveSimulators (https://livesimulators.com/) is an open-access platform executing real-time first-principles physical and mathematical models in modern web browsers at 60 FPS using Float64 numerical integrators (including 4th-Order Runge-Kutta). Built for university engineering syllabi, laboratory exploration, and industrial plant troubleshooting.

## Citation & Academic Attribution
To cite LiveSimulators or any individual simulator in academic literature, research papers, course syllabi, or lab manuals, use the following plain-text citation format:

Sharma, A. (2026). [Simulator Title]. LiveSimulators. Retrieved from https://livesimulators.com/simulator/[simulator-id]/

BibTeX entry format:
```bibtex
@misc{livesimulators_[simulator_id]_2026,
  author = {Sharma, A.},
  title = {[Simulator Title]},
  year = {2026},
  howpublished = {LiveSimulators},
  url = {https://livesimulators.com/simulator/[simulator-id]/}
}
```

## Engineering Departments & Curricular Taxonomy
Explore all engineering disciplines and their interactive mathematical curricula:
- [Electrical & Electronic Systems (EE-200)](https://livesimulators.com/department/electrical/): Analog circuits, switching power topologies, RF transmission lines, 3-phase grid power, and semiconductor dynamics. Core equation: `v(t) = L(di / dt) + Ri(t) + (1 / C)∫ i(t)dt`
- [Control Systems & Robotics (CS-300)](https://livesimulators.com/department/control/): Closed-loop feedback stability, PID gain tuning, root locus analysis, state-space representations, and inverted pendulum dynamics. Core equation: `u(t) = K_p e(t) + K_i ∫_0^t e(τ)dτ + K_d (de(t) / dt)`
- [Mechanical & Thermal Dynamics (ME-400)](https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical/): Damped harmonic oscillators, multi-degree-of-freedom vibrations, thermodynamic Carnot cycles, and heat transfer convection. Core equation: `mẍ + cẋ + kx = F_0 cos(ω t)`
- [Chemical & Process Engineering (CH-250)](https://livesimulators.com/department/chemical/): Continuous Stirred Tank Reactors (CSTR), McCabe-Thiele distillation columns, TEMA shell-and-tube heat exchangers, and packed gas absorbers. Core equation: `(dC_A / dt) = (F / V)(C_A0 - C_A) - k_0 e^-E_a/RT C_A^2`
- [Civil & Structural Mechanics (CE-320)](https://livesimulators.com/department/civil/): Truss axial stress distribution, Euler-Bernoulli beam deflection under uniform distributed loads, and seismic response spectra. Core equation: `EI (d^4 w / dx^4) = q(x)`
- [Quantum & Semiconductor Physics (PH-500)](https://livesimulators.com/department/physics/): P-N junction energy band bending, SiC MOSFET switching dynamics, IGBT multi-layer thermal Foster networks, and BSIM4 inversion channels. Core equation: `iħ (∂ / ∂ t) Ψ( r ,t) = [ -(ħ^2 / 2m)∇^2 + V( r ) ] Ψ( r ,t)`

## Simulators Grouped by Engineering Department

### Electrical & Electronic Systems (EE-200)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/department/electrical/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `v(t) = L(di / dt) + Ri(t) + (1 / C)∫ i(t)dt`
- **Core Subfields**: Power Electronics, RF & Transmission Lines, Analog Active Filters, 3-Phase AC Grids, Semiconductor Physics

Simulators:
- [RLC Resonant Circuit & Damping Transient](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rlc-resonance/): Observe underdamped ringing, critical damping, and impedance resonance in real time.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rlc-resonance/
  - Governing Equation: `ω_0 = (1 / √(LC)), ζ = (R / 2)√((C / L))`
  - Engineering Summary: Observe underdamped ringing, critical damping, and impedance resonance in real time.
  - Physical Law: Kirchhoff's Voltage Law & Faraday Induction | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [3-Phase AC Synchronous Motor & Rotating Field](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/three-phase-ac/): Track how three balanced 120° sinusoidal currents generate a continuous rotating stator flux vector.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/three-phase-ac/
  - Governing Equation: `vec(B)_net(t) = (3 / 2) B_m [ cos(ω t)i^ + sin(ω t)j^ ]`
  - Engineering Summary: Track how three balanced 120° sinusoidal currents generate a continuous rotating stator flux vector.
  - Physical Law: Faraday-Lenz Law & Lorentz Force Torque | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Buck-Boost DC-DC Switching Regulator](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/buck-boost-converter/): Explore inductor energy storage, Continuous vs Discontinuous mode, and voltage inversion.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/buck-boost-converter/
  - Governing Equation: `V_out = -V_in(D / 1 - D), Δ I_L = (V_in D / L f_sw)`
  - Engineering Summary: Explore inductor energy storage, Continuous vs Discontinuous mode, and voltage inversion.
  - Physical Law: Conservation of Energy & Volt-Second Balance | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [2nd-Order Sallen-Key Active Low-Pass Filter](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/sallen-key-filter/): Tweak component values to shape Butterworth, Chebyshev, or Bessel frequency responses.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/sallen-key-filter/
  - Governing Equation: `H(s) = (K ω_c^2 / s^2 + (ω_c / Q) s + ω_c^2), f_c = (1 / 2π √(R_1 R_2 C_1 C_2))`
  - Engineering Summary: Tweak component values to shape Butterworth, Chebyshev, or Bessel frequency responses.
  - Physical Law: Negative Feedback & Complex Pole Placement | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [RF Transmission Line & Reflection Coefficient](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/transmission-line/): See incident and reflected TEM voltage waves collide to form standing wave envelopes.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/transmission-line/
  - Governing Equation: `Gamma = (Z_L - Z_0 / Z_L + Z_0), VSWR = (1 + |Gamma| / 1 - |Gamma|)`
  - Engineering Summary: See incident and reflected TEM voltage waves collide to form standing wave envelopes.
  - Physical Law: Telegrapher's Equations & Boundary Wave Reflection | Difficulty: Advanced
- [Fourier Series Harmonic Decomposition & THD](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/fourier-synthesis/): Sum discrete sinusoidal harmonics to assemble square, triangle, and pulse waveforms.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/fourier-synthesis/
  - Governing Equation: `f(t) = (4 / π) ∑_n=1,3,5,dots^N (1 / n) sin(n ω_0 t)`
  - Engineering Summary: Sum discrete sinusoidal harmonics to assemble square, triangle, and pulse waveforms.
  - Physical Law: Orthogonality of Sinusoidal Basis Functions | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [Operational Amplifier (Op-Amp) Linear & Filter Topologies](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/op-amp-circuits/): Explore inverting, non-inverting, integrator, and differentiator op-amp circuits with supply rail saturation clipping.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/op-amp-circuits/
  - Governing Equation: `V_out = -(R_f / R_in) V_in (Inverting) , V_out = (1 + (R_f / R_in)) V_in (Non-Inverting)`
  - Engineering Summary: Explore inverting, non-inverting, integrator, and differentiator op-amp circuits with supply rail saturation clipping.
  - Physical Law: Ideal Op-Amp Golden Rules: Infinite Input Impedance (I_in = 0) & Virtual Short (V_+ = V_-) | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [RC & RL Circuit Transients & Exponential Time Constants](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rc-rl-transient/): Track charge accumulation, inductive kick, time constant τ, and 5τ settling response.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rc-rl-transient/
  - Governing Equation: `v_C(t) = V_0 (1 - e^-t/RC), i_L(t) = (V_0 / R) (1 - e^-t/(L/R))`
  - Engineering Summary: Track charge accumulation, inductive kick, time constant τ, and 5τ settling response.
  - Physical Law: Conservation of Electric Charge & Lenz-Faraday Magnetic Flux Invariance | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [Single-Phase Transformer OC & SC Tests (Equivalent Circuit)](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/transformer-oc-sc-test/): Extract core losses (Rc, Xm) and winding impedance (Req, Xeq) to calculate full-load efficiency and regulation.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/transformer-oc-sc-test/
  - Governing Equation: `R_c = (V_oc^2 / P_oc), X_m = (V_oc / I_m), R_eq = (P_sc / I_sc^2), X_eq = √(Z_sc^2 - R_eq^2)`
  - Engineering Summary: Extract core losses (Rc, Xm) and winding impedance (Req, Xeq) to calculate full-load efficiency and regulation.
  - Physical Law: Faraday Law of Induction, Ampere Biot-Savart Law & Steinmetz Core Loss | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [DC Shunt & Separately Excited Motor Speed Control](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/dc-motor-speed-control/): Master armature voltage regulation, field flux weakening, Ward-Leonard control, and speed-torque droop.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/dc-motor-speed-control/
  - Governing Equation: `ω = (V_t - I_a R_a / k_e Φ), T_e = k_t Φ I_a, E_b = k_e Φ ω`
  - Engineering Summary: Master armature voltage regulation, field flux weakening, Ward-Leonard control, and speed-torque droop.
  - Physical Law: Lorentz Force Law & Faraday Law of Counter-Electromotive Force | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [3-Phase Induction Motor Torque-Slip & Breakdown Speed](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/induction-motor-torque-slip/): Explore stator R-X parameters, starting torque, pull-out breakdown T_max, and rotor resistance effects.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/induction-motor-torque-slip/
  - Governing Equation: `T_e = (3 V_1,th^2 (R_2' / s) / ω_s [(R_th + R_2' / s)^2 + (X_th + X_2')^2]), s_max = (R_2' / √(R_th^2 + (X_th + X_2')^2))`
  - Engineering Summary: Explore stator R-X parameters, starting torque, pull-out breakdown T_max, and rotor resistance effects.
  - Physical Law: Faraday Electromagnetic Induction & Maximum Power Transfer Theorem | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Solar PV Cell Single-Diode Model & MPPT Tracking](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/solar-pv-mppt/): Simulate single-diode I-V & P-V curves, irradiance/temperature impacts, and P&O Maximum Power Point Tracking.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/solar-pv-mppt/
  - Governing Equation: `I = I_ph - I_0 [exp((q(V + I R_s) / n N_s k_B T)) - 1] - (V + I R_s / R_sh), P_max = V_mp I_mp`
  - Engineering Summary: Simulate single-diode I-V & P-V curves, irradiance/temperature impacts, and P&O Maximum Power Point Tracking.
  - Physical Law: Shockley Semiconductor Diode Equation & Photovoltaic Effect | Difficulty: Intermediate

### Control Systems & Robotics (CS-300)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/department/control/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `u(t) = K_p e(t) + K_i ∫_0^t e(τ)dτ + K_d (de(t) / dt)`
- **Core Subfields**: PID Controllers, Bode & Nyquist Plots, State-Space Feedback, Inverted Pendulum, Robotic Kinematics

Simulators:
- [Industrial Closed-Loop PID Tuning & Anti-Windup](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/pid-tuning/): Tune proportional, integral, and derivative gains with integrator anti-windup clamping.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/pid-tuning/
  - Governing Equation: `u(t) = K_p e(t) + (K_p / T_i) ∫_0^t e(τ)dτ + K_p T_d (de(t) / dt)`
  - Engineering Summary: Tune proportional, integral, and derivative gains with integrator anti-windup clamping.
  - Physical Law: Nyquist Stability & Classical Negative Feedback | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Pneumatic Control Valve Flow Cv & Cavitation](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/control-valve/): Compare Linear, Equal-Percentage, and Quick-Opening trims under varying differential pressures.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/control-valve/
  - Governing Equation: `Q = C_v N_1 F_p √((Δ P / SG)), σ_c = (P_1 - P_v / Δ P)`
  - Engineering Summary: Compare Linear, Equal-Percentage, and Quick-Opening trims under varying differential pressures.
  - Physical Law: Bernoulli Fluid Continuity & Cavitation Choking | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [4-20mA Current Loop Transmitter & Line Resistance](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/current-loop/): Simulate 2-wire smart transmitters, cable loop resistance drops, and NAMUR fault alarms.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/current-loop/
  - Governing Equation: `I_loop = 4 mA + 16 mA ((PV - LRV / URV - LRV)), V_term = V_s - I_loop(R_wire + R_load)`
  - Engineering Summary: Simulate 2-wire smart transmitters, cable loop resistance drops, and NAMUR fault alarms.
  - Physical Law: Ohm’s Law & Kirchhoff’s Voltage Loop | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [Differential Pressure Orifice Plate Flowmeter](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/orifice-meter/): Calculate volumetric flow through concentric thin-plate square-edge orifices and tap dP.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/orifice-meter/
  - Governing Equation: `q_m = (C_d / √(1 - β^4)) ε (π / 4) d^2 √(2 ρ Δ P), β = (d / D)`
  - Engineering Summary: Calculate volumetric flow through concentric thin-plate square-edge orifices and tap dP.
  - Physical Law: Bernoulli Conservation of Fluid Energy & Continuity | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Bode Plot & Nyquist Diagram Frequency Stability](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/bode-nyquist-stability/): Evaluate Gain Margin, Phase Margin, crossover frequencies, and Cauchy stability encirclements.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/bode-nyquist-stability/
  - Governing Equation: `G(jω) = (K ω_n^2 / -ω^2 + 2jζω_nω + ω_n^2) e^-jω T_d`
  - Engineering Summary: Evaluate Gain Margin, Phase Margin, crossover frequencies, and Cauchy stability encirclements.
  - Physical Law: Cauchy Argument Principle & Nyquist Stability Criterion (Z = N + P) | Difficulty: Advanced
- [Root Locus Plotter & Closed-Loop Stability Analysis](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/root-locus-plotter/): Trace closed-loop pole trajectories across the complex s-plane as feedback gain K varies from 0 to ∞.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/root-locus-plotter/
  - Governing Equation: `1 + K G(s)H(s) = 0 ⟹ |K G(s)H(s)| = 1, ∠ G(s)H(s) = ± (2k + 1)180^circ`
  - Engineering Summary: Trace closed-loop pole trajectories across the complex s-plane as feedback gain K varies from 0 to ∞.
  - Physical Law: Cauchy Argument Principle & Evans Closed-Loop Characteristic Stability | Difficulty: Advanced

### Mechanical & Thermal Dynamics (ME-400)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `mẍ + cẋ + kx = F_0 cos(ω t)`
- **Core Subfields**: Vibration & Resonance, Carnot & Rankine Cycles, Heat Exchanger Conduction, Gear Train Dynamics, Fluid Bernouilli Flow

Simulators:
- [Planar 4-Bar Grashof Kinematics & Coupler Curves](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/four-bar-mechanism/): Synthesize crank-rocker vs double-crank inversions and trace continuous coupler point trajectories.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/four-bar-mechanism/
  - Governing Equation: `s + l ≤ p + q, K_1 cosθ_4 - K_2 cosθ_2 + K_3 = cos(θ_2 - θ_4)`
  - Engineering Summary: Synthesize crank-rocker vs double-crank inversions and trace continuous coupler point trajectories.
  - Physical Law: Grashof Mechanism Inversion & Loop-Closure Constraint | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Thermodynamic Rankine Steam Power Cycle](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rankine-cycle/): Track steam expansion through high-pressure boilers, turbines, condensers, and feed pumps on a T-s diagram.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rankine-cycle/
  - Governing Equation: `η_th = (w_net / q_in) = ((h_1 - h_2) - (h_4 - h_3) / h_1 - h_4)`
  - Engineering Summary: Track steam expansion through high-pressure boilers, turbines, condensers, and feed pumps on a T-s diagram.
  - Physical Law: First & Second Laws of Thermodynamics (ASME PTC 4.4) | Difficulty: Advanced
- [Damped Forced Harmonic Oscillator & Resonance Peak](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/harmonic-oscillator/): Visualize mass-spring-damper resonance, phase lag φ(ω), and displacement amplification M(ω).
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/harmonic-oscillator/
  - Governing Equation: `mẍ + cẋ + kx = F_0 cos(ω t), M(ω) = (1 / √((1-r^2)^2 + (2ζ r)^2))`
  - Engineering Summary: Visualize mass-spring-damper resonance, phase lag φ(ω), and displacement amplification M(ω).
  - Physical Law: Newton’s 2nd Law & Hookean Elastic Restoration | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [Involute Spur Gear Mesh Dynamics & Backlash](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/spur-gear-mesh/): Track tooth contact along the line of action, verify contact ratio CR ≥ 1.4, and check sliding velocity.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/spur-gear-mesh/
  - Governing Equation: `r_b = r cos α, CR = (√(r_a1^2 - r_b1^2) + √(r_a2^2 - r_b2^2) - Csinα / p_b)`
  - Engineering Summary: Track tooth contact along the line of action, verify contact ratio CR ≥ 1.4, and check sliding velocity.
  - Physical Law: Fundamental Law of Conjugate Gearing | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Otto & Diesel Internal Combustion Thermodynamic Cycles](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/otto-diesel-cycle/): Analyze 4-stroke spark-ignition and compression-ignition P-V diagrams with moving piston kinematics.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/otto-diesel-cycle/
  - Governing Equation: `η_Otto = 1 - (1 / r^γ - 1), η_Diesel = 1 - (1 / r^γ-1) [ (r_c^γ - 1 / γ(r_c - 1)) ]`
  - Engineering Summary: Analyze 4-stroke spark-ignition and compression-ignition P-V diagrams with moving piston kinematics.
  - Physical Law: First and Second Laws of Thermodynamics & Ideal Gas Law PV = mRT | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Projectile Motion & Ballistics with Aerodynamic Drag](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/projectile-motion-drag/): Compare ideal vacuum parabolic trajectory against realistic quadratic atmospheric air drag.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/projectile-motion-drag/
  - Governing Equation: `m (dvec(v) / dt) = mvec(g) - (1 / 2)ρ C_d A |vec(v)|vec(v)`
  - Engineering Summary: Compare ideal vacuum parabolic trajectory against realistic quadratic atmospheric air drag.
  - Physical Law: Newton’s Second Law of Motion & Fluid Dynamic Drag Equation | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [Centrifugal Pump & System Hydraulic Operating Point](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/centrifugal-pump-curves/): Find the duty point (Q_duty, H_duty), evaluate affinity laws, hydraulic efficiency, and NPSHr margin.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/centrifugal-pump-curves/
  - Governing Equation: `H = H_0 - k_p Q^2, H_sys = H_stat + k_pipe Q^2, (Q_1 / Q_2) = (N_1 / N_2), (H_1 / H_2) = ((N_1 / N_2))^2`
  - Engineering Summary: Find the duty point (Q_duty, H_duty), evaluate affinity laws, hydraulic efficiency, and NPSHr margin.
  - Physical Law: Euler Turbomachinery Equation, Bernoulli Conservation & Darcy-Weisbach Pipeline Friction | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Vapor-Compression Refrigeration & Heat Pump Cycle](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/refrigeration-heat-pump/): Plot the P-h diagram, evaluate evaporator subcooling/superheat, compressor isentropic efficiency, and COP.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/refrigeration-heat-pump/
  - Governing Equation: `COP _R = (q_in / w_net) = (h_1 - h_4 / h_2 - h_1), COP _HP = COP _R + 1, η_II = ( COP _R / COP _Carnot)`
  - Engineering Summary: Plot the P-h diagram, evaluate evaporator subcooling/superheat, compressor isentropic efficiency, and COP.
  - Physical Law: First & Second Laws of Thermodynamics & Clausius-Clapeyron Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium | Difficulty: Intermediate

### Chemical & Process Engineering (CH-250)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/department/chemical/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `(dC_A / dt) = (F / V)(C_A0 - C_A) - k_0 e^-E_a/RT C_A^2`
- **Core Subfields**: CSTR Chemical Kinetics, McCabe-Thiele Distillation, TEMA Shell & Tube Exchangers, Packed Gas Absorbers, Reaction Thermodynamics

Simulators:
- [Non-Isothermal CSTR & Thermal Runaway Dynamics](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/cstr-kinetics/): Simulate continuous reaction kinetics, cooling jacket heat transfer, and thermal runaway thresholds.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/cstr-kinetics/
  - Governing Equation: `V (dC_A / dt) = F(C_A0 - C_A) - V k_0 e^-E_a/RT C_A, V ρ C_p (dT / dt) = F ρ C_p(T_0 - T) + (-Δ H) V r_A - U A (T - T_c)`
  - Engineering Summary: Simulate continuous reaction kinetics, cooling jacket heat transfer, and thermal runaway thresholds.
  - Physical Law: Conservation of Mass, Arrhenius Law & First Law of Thermodynamics | Difficulty: Advanced
- [Binary Distillation Column & McCabe-Thiele Stages](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/distillation-column/): Step through McCabe-Thiele theoretical equilibrium trays, adjust reflux ratio, and evaluate minimum reflux R_min.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/distillation-column/
  - Governing Equation: `y = (α x / 1 + (α - 1)x), y = (R / R+1)x + (x_D / R+1), y = (q / q-1)x - (z_F / q-1)`
  - Engineering Summary: Step through McCabe-Thiele theoretical equilibrium trays, adjust reflux ratio, and evaluate minimum reflux R_min.
  - Physical Law: Raoult's Law & Conservation of Mass and Enthalpy (AIChE) | Difficulty: Advanced
- [Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger & ε-NTU Rating](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/heat-exchanger/): Evaluate countercurrent thermal gradients, logarithmic mean temperature difference (LMTD), and ε-NTU effectiveness.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/heat-exchanger/
  - Governing Equation: `Q = U A F · LMTD , ε = (1 - exp(- NTU (1 - C_r)) / 1 - C_r exp(- NTU (1 - C_r))), NTU = (UA / C_min)`
  - Engineering Summary: Evaluate countercurrent thermal gradients, logarithmic mean temperature difference (LMTD), and ε-NTU effectiveness.
  - Physical Law: Fourier's Law of Conduction, Newton's Law of Cooling & Conservation of Energy (TEMA) | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Packed Gas Absorption Tower & Flooding Hydraulics](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/gas-absorption/): Simulate countercurrent solvent scrubbing, calculate packing height Z via HTU-NTU, and detect Sherwood flooding limits.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/gas-absorption/
  - Governing Equation: `N_A = K_y(y - y^*), Z = HTU _OG · NTU _OG, NTU _OG = ∫_y_2^y_1 (dy / y - y^*)`
  - Engineering Summary: Simulate countercurrent solvent scrubbing, calculate packing height Z via HTU-NTU, and detect Sherwood flooding limits.
  - Physical Law: Whitman Two-Film Theory & Sherwood-Eckert Flooding Hydrodynamics | Difficulty: Advanced
- [Batch Reactor & Plug Flow Reactor (PFR) Kinetics](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/batch-pfr-kinetics/): Compare 1st vs 2nd order kinetics, Arrhenius temperature sensitivity, Damköhler number Da, and conversion X_A.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/batch-pfr-kinetics/
  - Governing Equation: `-(dC_A / dt) = k(T) C_A^n, k(T) = k_0 exp(-(E_a / R T)), X_A = 1 - (C_A / C_A0), Da = k C_A0^n-1 τ`
  - Engineering Summary: Compare 1st vs 2nd order kinetics, Arrhenius temperature sensitivity, Damköhler number Da, and conversion X_A.
  - Physical Law: Law of Mass Action & Arrhenius Activation Energy Kinetics | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Liquid-Liquid Extraction (LLE) & Ternary Phase Equilibrium](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/liquid-extraction/): Simulate countercurrent solvent extraction, binodal phase envelopes, and Hunter-Nash equilibrium stages.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/liquid-extraction/
  - Governing Equation: `K_D = (y_B / x_B), N = (ln[(1 - (1 / E_f))((x_F - y_S/m / x_R - y_S/m)) + (1 / E_f)] / ln(E_f)), E_f = (m S / F)`
  - Engineering Summary: Simulate countercurrent solvent extraction, binodal phase envelopes, and Hunter-Nash equilibrium stages.
  - Physical Law: Nernst Distribution Law & Hunter-Nash Ternary Liquid-Liquid Phase Equilibrium | Difficulty: Intermediate

### Civil & Structural Mechanics (CE-320)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/department/civil/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `EI (d^4 w / dx^4) = q(x)`
- **Core Subfields**: Beam Bending & Shear, Warren & Pratt Trusses, Buckling Instability, Seismic Base Isolation, Soil Consolidation

Simulators:
- [Euler-Bernoulli Beam Deflection, Shear & Moment](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/beam-bending/): Calculate Shear Force Diagrams (SFD), Bending Moments (BMD), and elastic deflection profiles.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/beam-bending/
  - Governing Equation: `EI (d^4 w / dx^4) = q(x), σ_max = (M_max y / I)`
  - Engineering Summary: Calculate Shear Force Diagrams (SFD), Bending Moments (BMD), and elastic deflection profiles.
  - Physical Law: Euler-Bernoulli Beam Theory & Hooke’s Law | Difficulty: Fundamentals
- [Warren & Pratt Truss Bridge Analysis](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/truss-bridge/): Solve Method of Joints 2D nodal equilibrium under moving deck truck live loads and check Euler buckling.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/truss-bridge/
  - Governing Equation: `∑ vec(F)_node = 0, P_cr = (π^2 E I / (K L)^2)`
  - Engineering Summary: Solve Method of Joints 2D nodal equilibrium under moving deck truck live loads and check Euler buckling.
  - Physical Law: Newton’s Static Equilibrium & Euler Column Buckling | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Seismic Base Isolation & Dynamic Multi-Story Response](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/seismic-base-isolation/): Compare conventional fixed-base vs elastomeric Lead-Rubber Bearing (LRB) building lateral drift.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/seismic-base-isolation/
  - Governing Equation: `M ü + C u̇ + K u = -M ü_g(t), T_n = 2π √((m / k))`
  - Engineering Summary: Compare conventional fixed-base vs elastomeric Lead-Rubber Bearing (LRB) building lateral drift.
  - Physical Law: Newton’s Second Law & Elastomeric Hysteresis | Difficulty: Advanced
- [Mohr’s Circle of Stress & Soil Shear Slip Failure](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/mohr-circle-soil/): Transform 2D normal and shear stresses to principal axes (σ₁, σ₂) and evaluate Coulomb failure envelopes.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/mohr-circle-soil/
  - Governing Equation: `τ_f = c + σ_n tan φ, R = √(((σ_x - σ_y / 2))^2 + τ_xy^2)`
  - Engineering Summary: Transform 2D normal and shear stresses to principal axes (σ₁, σ₂) and evaluate Coulomb failure envelopes.
  - Physical Law: Stress Tensor Coordinate Transformation & Coulomb Friction | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Reinforced Concrete Beam Flexural Design & Whitney Stress Block](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rc-beam-design/): Calculate nominal moment capacity Mn, Whitney block depth a, rebar strain εt, and tension-controlled safety.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rc-beam-design/
  - Governing Equation: `M_n = A_s f_y (d - (a / 2)), a = (A_s f_y / 0.85 f'_c b), c = (a / β_1), ε_t = 0.003 (d - c / c)`
  - Engineering Summary: Calculate nominal moment capacity Mn, Whitney block depth a, rebar strain εt, and tension-controlled safety.
  - Physical Law: Euler-Bernoulli Plane Sections Remain Plane & Internal Moment Couple Equilibrium | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Euler Column Buckling & P-Delta Instability](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/column-buckling/): Calculate elastic critical bifurcation loads, effective length K factors, and non-linear P-Δ amplification.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/column-buckling/
  - Governing Equation: `P_cr = (π^2 E I / (K L)^2), σ_cr = (π^2 E / λ^2), λ = (K L / r)`
  - Engineering Summary: Calculate elastic critical bifurcation loads, effective length K factors, and non-linear P-Δ amplification.
  - Physical Law: Euler's Buckling Theory & Geometric Non-Linearity (P-Δ Effect) | Difficulty: Intermediate

### Quantum & Semiconductor Physics (PH-500)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/department/physics/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `iħ (∂ / ∂ t) Ψ( r ,t) = [ -(ħ^2 / 2m)∇^2 + V( r ) ] Ψ( r ,t)`
- **Core Subfields**: P-N Diode Band Diagram, SiC MOSFET Double-Pulse, IGBT Thermal Foster Model, MOSFET Inversion Channel, Quantum Well Tunneling

Simulators:
- [P-N Junction Diode Band Bending & Carrier Transport](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/pn-junction/): Visualize energy band bending (Ec, Ev, Ef), space-charge depletion width, and carrier drift-diffusion.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/pn-junction/
  - Governing Equation: `W = √((2ε_s / q)((1 / N_A) + (1 / N_D))(V_bi - V_a)), I = I_s(e^qV_a / k_B T - 1)`
  - Engineering Summary: Visualize energy band bending (Ec, Ev, Ef), space-charge depletion width, and carrier drift-diffusion.
  - Physical Law: Poisson's Electrostatic Equation & Fermi-Dirac Carrier Distribution | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFET Double-Pulse Switching & Slew Rates](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/sic-switching/): Capture ultra-fast dv/dt (up to 100 V/ns), Miller plateau dynamics, inductive ringing, and switching energy losses E_on / E_off.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/sic-switching/
  - Governing Equation: `E_sw = ∫_0^t_sw v_ds(t) · i_d(t) dt, ((dv / dt))_max = (V_gs - V_plat / R_g,tot C_gd(V_ds))`
  - Engineering Summary: Capture ultra-fast dv/dt (up to 100 V/ns), Miller plateau dynamics, inductive ringing, and switching energy losses E_on / E_off.
  - Physical Law: Maxwell's Displacement Current, Carrier Drift-Diffusion & Parasitic RLC Resonant Tank | Difficulty: Advanced
- [IGBT Module Multi-Layer Thermal Foster Network & SOA](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/igbt-thermal/): Model multi-layer conduction from Silicon Die through DBC ceramic and baseplate to heatsink, tracking T_j ripple.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/igbt-thermal/
  - Governing Equation: `Z_th(t) = ∑_i=1^4 R_i (1 - e^-t / τ_i), T_j(t) = T_a + P_tot R_th(j-a) + Δ T_j,ripple`
  - Engineering Summary: Model multi-layer conduction from Silicon Die through DBC ceramic and baseplate to heatsink, tracking T_j ripple.
  - Physical Law: Fourier Heat Conduction & Electro-Thermal Network Analogy (JEDEC JESD51) | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [MOSFET Inversion Channel, Band Bending & 2D Electron Gas](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/mosfet-channel/): Solve surface potential band bending, visualize 2D electron sheet accumulation, and observe channel pinch-off.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/mosfet-channel/
  - Governing Equation: `φ_s = (q N_A W_dep^2 / 2ε_s), Q_inv = -C_ox(V_gs - V_th), I_D = μ C_ox (W / L)[(V_gs - V_th)V_ds - (V_ds^2 / 2)]`
  - Engineering Summary: Solve surface potential band bending, visualize 2D electron sheet accumulation, and observe channel pinch-off.
  - Physical Law: Poisson-Boltzmann Electrostatics & Fermi-Dirac Statistics (BSIM4) | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Photoelectric Effect & Einstein Quantum Work Function](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/photoelectric-effect/): Verify quantum photon particle theory, metal work functions Φ, and stopping potential V_stop.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/photoelectric-effect/
  - Governing Equation: `K_max = hν - Φ = q V_stop`
  - Engineering Summary: Verify quantum photon particle theory, metal work functions Φ, and stopping potential V_stop.
  - Physical Law: Planck-Einstein Quantum Relation E = hν & Energy Conservation | Difficulty: Intermediate
- [Quantum Barrier Tunneling & Resonant Diode (RTD) NDR](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/quantum-tunneling/): Simulate WKB barrier tunneling, resonant double-barrier transmission, and negative differential resistance.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/quantum-tunneling/
  - Governing Equation: `T(E) ≈ exp(-2 ∫_x_1^x_2 √((2m^* / ħ^2)big(V(x) - Ebig)) dx), I(V) = (2e / h)∫ T(E,V)big(f_L(E) - f_R(E)big) dE`
  - Engineering Summary: Simulate WKB barrier tunneling, resonant double-barrier transmission, and negative differential resistance.
  - Physical Law: Time-Independent Schrödinger Equation & WKB Wavepacket Tunneling | Difficulty: Advanced
